item.title: YES Bank shares in focus on Monday: Lender appoints Vinay Muralidhar Tonse as MD, CEO designate
item.description: Tonse would serve in the designated role from March 12, 2026, until April 5, 2026. He is slated to officially take the helm as the full-time MD and CEO on April 6, 2026, the company said.

item.title: UltraTech Cement to buy 26% stake in Sunsure Solarpark Thirty Eight; key details
item.description: On Friday at close, UltraTech Cement shares declined 2.56% to Rs 11986.75 apiece on BSE, dipping from the previous close of Rs 12301.85 per share.

item.title: Ranveer Singh-led Dhurandhar 2's trailer out; what we know about its story, cast, box office prediction
item.description: The trailer features adrenaline-packed action scenes from the likes of Ranveer Singh, Sanjay Dutt and Arjun Rampal.

item.title: West Asia conflict may hurt Indian economy; oil, rice, gems among 15 sectors at risk, warns expert
item.description: Rising tensions in the Middle East could have wide-ranging economic consequences for India, affecting oil prices, trade costs, currency movement and multiple domestic industries. Experts warn that as many as 15 sectors — from aviation and rice exports to gems, chemicals and fertilisers — may face direct or indirect impact if the conflict escalates.

item.title: Pakistan raises fuel prices 20%; petrol at PKR 321, diesel PKR 335 as Iran war drives oil surge
item.description: The government raised prices by PKR 55 per litre, pushing petrol to PKR 321.17 per litre and high-speed diesel to PKR 335.86 per litre, one of the steepest increases in recent years. The hike comes as tensions in West Asia intensify following military strikes involving Iran, Israel and the United States.

item.title: US-Israel-Iran War Live: Saudi Arabia's Defence Minister warns Iran, loud explosions rock Abu Dhabi
item.description: US-Israel-Iran War Live updates: Authorities said that defence systems intercepted attempted strikes on air base hosting US troops and a major oil field in Saudi Arabia.

item.title: 'Our allies in India good actors': Scott Bessent on 30-day waiver for Russian oil shipments despite sanctions
item.description: In a post on X, Bessent said global oil markets remain well supplied due to the US administration’s policy of “American Energy Dominance.”

item.title: US commits up to $20 billion in reinsurance for maritime losses in Gulf region: Report
item.description: The new reinsurance support will be provided on a rolling basis, with initial attention given to hull and machinery as well as cargo insurance, according to the DFC.

item.title: 20% of global oil at risk as Hormuz blockade halts ships; crude surges 36% in a week of Iran-Israel conflict
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz is a key global energy chokepoint, carrying about 20% of world oil trade and major LNG flows. Any disruption can hit global markets, with import-dependent Asian economies like India, China, Japan and South Korea most exposed.
